topics.title: Horace Danby: a respectable man with a secret

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how Horace Danby appears respectable to others while secretly being a thief.
Explain why Horace robs one safe every year and how he spends the money.

topics.title: The planned robbery at Shotover Grange

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the careful preparations Horace makes before breaking into Shotover Grange.
Explain how Horace's hay fever hinders him and gives away his presence.

topics.title: The lady in red and the deception

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse the subtle ways in which the young lady convinces Horace that she owns the house.
Interpret the arguments Horace uses to justify his stealing and to persuade the lady to let him go.

topics.title: The arrest and the irony of honour among thieves

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how Horace is caught and why nobody believes his story.
Evaluate the irony of the ending and which saying about thieves the story illustrates.
